responsibility: Extract structured FF&E specs from PDF price books, fact sheets, or spec sheets into a schedule. Use for product PDFs; not web URLs or EPDs.
inputs: Supplied task and selected source scope; exact destination only for requested persistence or application work. Load project context only when the task needs project records.

modes.when: Read exact supplied PDF bytes, full page/annotation evidence and selected native semantic/schema resources; process access is optional for the chosen native method.
Only when a standalone derived CSV/JSON/report is explicitly requested; inline extraction and validation require no write.

Only for a requested owner handoff: reusable CSV changes to product-library, accepted inputs to product-data-import, adopted records to master-schedule and registered reports to receive; preserve exact authorization, targets, evidence and current revisions.
Only when the requested evidence handoff needs actual native workbook values, formulas, links, images and structure.

Only for an explicitly requested native workbook edit with suitable backup/provider revision, mapped extraction and preserved features; adopted reconciliation and canonical changes remain master-schedule-owned.
